India's regional AI startup ecosystem is seeing a massive influx of capital, but almost all of it is going to one single player. Out of the $399 million invested in Indian-language AI startups this year through mid-October, roughly $346 million went straight to Sarvam. While this concentrated funding allows Sarvam to hire top researchers and improve its technology, it raises serious questions about the broader market's competitive future.
